verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI supports proxy chains with automatic retry/fallback and undetected browser mode to bypass bot detection, but there is no evidence of built-in support for premium residential/datacenter proxy providers or proxy rotation services—users must bring and configure their own proxies. missing for 10: no documented integration with residential/datacenter proxy providers, no proxy rotation/pool management features, no independent evidence of successful bypass on hard-to-scrape sites using proxies.
